caption:
Site broke after an update? Find the culprit in minutes. 🔧

1️⃣ Plugins > Installed Plugins > select all > Deactivate
2️⃣ Reload the site. Fixed? A plugin is the cause.
3️⃣ Turn plugins back on one at a time, reloading after each

The one that breaks it again is your culprit.

📌 Save this for later.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#wordpress #wordpresstips #wordpressfix #plugins #website #webdesign #troubleshooting #wpadmin #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: One plugin is breaking your site. Which one?
scenes.say: One plugin is breaking your site. Which one? Find it in minutes.

scenes.title: Turn them all off
scenes.say: First, turn them all off. Open Plugins, select all, choose Deactivate, then reload your site.

left.title: Still broken
left.text: Not a plugin. Check your theme.

right.title: Fixed
right.text: A plugin is the cause. Keep going.

scenes.say: Still broken? It is not a plugin, so check your theme. Fixed? A plugin is the cause.

scenes.title: Turn them back on, one by one
scenes.body: Reload after each. The one that breaks it is your culprit.
scenes.say: Now turn them back on one at a time. Reload after each one. The plugin that breaks the site is your culprit.

scenes.title: Locked out of wp-admin?
scenes.body: Rename the plugins folder using your host's File Manager.
scenes.say: Locked out of your dashboard? Rename the plugins folder in your host's file manager instead.
